latHint: Think a sudden fall in share prices - not an avalanche.
pivHint: A SLIDE of snow thunders down a mountain - but a SLIDE in share prices is a sudden ______.
winText: Downhill. SLIDE was the pivot - snow SLIDE to a market SLUMP.
lossText: SLUMP - a sudden drop. SLIDE was the pivot: snow SLIDE to a SLIDE in prices.
